title: Effect of Mirror Therapy Versus Bilateral Arm Training for Rehabilitation After Chronic Stroke
brief_summary: The study purpose is to compare the efficacy of mirror therapy and bilateral arm training on movement strategies of the affected upper extremity and functional outcome in chronic stroke patients.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* more than 6 months after onset of an ischemic or hemorrhage stroke
* no excessive spasticity on all joints of the affected arm

Exclusion Criteria:

* history of stroke or other neurologic, neuromuscular, or orthopedic disease
* participation in other experimental rehabilitation or drug studies concurrent with this study
